# has tuning frame

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasTuningFrame`](gmeow-hasTuningFrame.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasTuningFrame>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/music`](../../slices/music.md)

The tuning system relative to which this pitch value or interval is expressed. Non-functional globally so that higher-level musical entities may carry multiple coexisting tuning frames (e.g., a detuned guitar over a 12-EDO synth); each [`PitchValue`](../classes/gmeow-PitchValue.md)/PitchInterval is constrained to exactly one frame by SHACL ([Principle 11](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-11)).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:PitchExpression`](../classes/gmeow-PitchExpression.md) -> [`gmeow:TuningSystem`](../classes/gmeow-TuningSystem.md)
**Sub-property of:** [`gmeow:hasReferenceFrame`](gmeow-hasReferenceFrame.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:hasTuningFrame`](gmeow-hasTuningFrame.md) from [`gmeow:PitchExpression`](../classes/gmeow-PitchExpression.md) to [`gmeow:TuningSystem`](../classes/gmeow-TuningSystem.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
